name: methyltransferase 14, N6-adenosine-methyltransferase non-catalytic subunit

function.text: METTL14 is the approved symbol for methyltransferase 14, N6-adenosine-methyltransferase non-catalytic subunit. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in mRNA binding; mRNA m(6)A methyltransferase activity; DNA damage response.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Nasopharyngeal carcinoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma; Endometrial carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: METTL14 encodes methyltransferase 14, N6-adenosine-methyltransferase non-catalytic subunit. Its functions include mRNA binding and mRNA m(6)A methyltransferase activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving METTL14 have been reported in endometrial carcinoma, nasopharyngeal carcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
